task.description:
Execute the OIDC-10 test suite and produce a structured test report.

1. Run unit tests: zig build test (must exit 0)
2. Run integration tests: set BPM_TEST_DB_URL and run zig build test-integration-oidc10 (must exit 0)
3. Write test report to tests/reports/report-WF02-oidc10-20260527-step04.json
4. Report format per test guide section 8:
   - Test run metadata (run_id, step, agent, timestamp)
   - Test summary by layer (unit, integration)
   - Detailed results per test case
   - Issues list (severity: BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR)
5. Commit and push to feature/WF02-oidc10-20260527
acceptance_criteria: All OIDC-10 MUST acceptance criteria pass
No skipped tests on MUST requirements

result.summary: All OIDC-10 test layers passed — unit (5/5) and integration (9/9), 0 failures, 0 skipped
